思考： Data has 10 rows, temperature 20-29. mean = 24.5.

Now write analysis.py.

$ cat > analysis.py << 'EOF'
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path

DATA = Path("data/temperature.csv")
RESULT = Path("result.json")
REPORT = Path("report.md")

with DATA.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
    temps = [float(row["temperature"]) for row in csv.DictReader(f)]

stats = {
    "count": len(temps),
    "mean": sum(temps) / len(temps),
    "max": max(temps),
    "min": min(temps),
}

RESULT.write_text(json.dumps(stats, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

REPORT.write_text(
    "# 温度统计分析报告\n\n"
    f"- 样本数：{stats['count']}\n"
    f"- 平均温度：{stats['mean']}°C\n"
    f"- 最高温度：{stats['max']}°C\n"
    f"- 最低温度：{stats['min']}°C\n",
    encoding="utf-8",
)
print("done:", stats)
EOF
